title: Anyone been at this word with a hostile ecology
content: There is a world that I dream of often. It’s not here, and I’ve been all around it. I haven’t seen a full map that I remember, but its bigger than earth. It has an incredibly large amount of uninhabitable land, think the size of an entire continent. It’s uninhabitable due to brutal cold mountain ranges spanning half of a continent. Other parts have miles upon miles of volcanoes constantly erupting. But you can fly over some parts of it which is how I know. Also has peculiar things, like beaches that have slush ice all over the beach or something that looks like slush and dead fish washing up that look tropical but it’s an extremely cold area. High way systems in cities are insane. Think dozens 1000ft thin bridges overlapping each other. Horrifying.
